detail.title: ICE20 Magnetic Phone Cooling Fan with Temperature Display - Black
detail.overview: The Ant ICE20 is a magnetic semiconductor phone cooler designed for mobile gamers, live streamers and content creators who need their device to stay cool through long recording or gaming sessions. It offers two mounting options — magnetic attachment or back-clip fixation — so it fits comfortably with most phone sizes and cases. Three adjustable quick-cooling levels let you dial in the intensity based on how hot the device is running, while a large chilling plate delivers rapid heat reduction as soon as it's powered on. A built-in LED temperature display shows live readings, and colourful ambient lighting plus a mech-inspired alloy, PC and carbon-fibre-textured body give it a distinct look on any streaming or gaming setup.
